name: Shipstar
description:
Shipstar is automated product marketing for engineers and agents. Connect a Shipstar project to this connector and Claude can drive the full content pipeline from your shipped code:

- Generate changelogs, blog posts, knowledge base articles, release notes emails, feature pages, X threads, and LinkedIn posts from your recent GitHub commits
- Poll generation status, read drafts, revise them, and approve or publish — the same lifecycle the Shipstar dashboard drives
- Send release notes emails to your project's mailing lists, and read everything you've already published

Each OAuth connection is scoped to exactly one Shipstar project, chosen on the consent screen. Read tools are annotated read-only; publishing and email sends only happen through explicit tool calls. Requires a Shipstar account (free plan available) with a connected GitHub repository.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Shipstar to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Shipstar to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.shipstar.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Shipstar MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shipstar lists 23 MCP tools, including approve_content, generate_blog_post, generate_blog_post_ideas, generate_changelog, generate_feature_page, generate_kb_articles, generate_linkedin_post, generate_release_notes_email, generate_twitter_thread, get_blog_post, get_changelog, and get_content_draft.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Shipstar?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Shipstar in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Shipstar requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Shipstar is developed by Shipstar. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
